label: admin_channels property (Sync Gateway)
type: the per-user (or per-role) property, set via the Admin REST API, granting static channel access - one of the three sources sgw:all-channels-property's computed union merges (the other two being access()-granted channels and inherited role channels).
note: The mechanism round 3's access-control-concepts.json first modelled; this round's dedicated verify-access and db-security reference pages corroborate it as the REST-configured leg of the union.
